question: What is the CO2 per capita of the country with the highest GDP per capita (the rightmost point, about $132,000)? (A) about 8 t (B) about 25 t (C) about 38 t. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate scatter chart. The y-axis uses a log scale for linear data. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate log scale. True answer: C (about 38 t). Bait: B (about 25 t).
